contrasts.line: Soaked means liquid went right through. Damp means only a little moisture.
Soaked is about liquid reaching through. Soggy is about turning limp or mushy.
Soaked means full through. Dripping means liquid is coming off in drops.
Soaked describes a thing filled through. Humid describes sticky air.
Damp is only a little moisture. Soaked is through and through.
Damp is light moisture. Soggy means limp or mushy from moisture.
Damp may leave a faint mark. Dripping has drops coming off.
Damp describes a lightly moist thing. Humid describes sticky air.
Soggy means limp or mushy. Soaked means liquid has reached right through.
Soggy is limp or mushy. Damp is just a little moist.
Soggy has lost crunch or shape. Dripping has drops coming off now.
Soggy describes a limp thing. Humid describes sticky air.
Dripping means drops are coming off. Soaked means liquid has gone through.
Dripping has drops coming off. Damp is only a little moist.
Dripping is about drops coming off. Soggy is about limp, mushy texture.
Dripping describes a thing shedding drops. Humid describes sticky air.
Humid is sticky air. Soaked is a thing wet through.
Humid is sticky air. Damp is a little moisture on a thing.
Humid describes air. Soggy describes something limp or mushy.
Humid is moisture in the air. Dripping means drops are coming off.
